videos.overview: Jason Mohammad presents highlights of the day's two Premier League derby matches. Arsenal face Southampton, while Chelsea entertain London rivals West Ham. There is also Goal of the Month and a round-up of the goals from Saturday's Premier League games, including both the Manchester and Merseyside derbies.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 15th April 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day's Premier League games. Newcastle United host Arsenal at St James' Park, while West Bromwich Albion make the trip to Old Trafford to take on Manchester United. There is also a chance to see all the goals and major incidents from Saturday's games.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 22nd April 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day's Premier League games. The leaders Manchester City take on Swansea at the Etihad, Arsenal face West Ham in a London derby, and relegation-threatened Stoke play Burnley. Plus the winner of the PFA Player of the Year award is revealed.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 29nd April 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day's two Premier League matches. Old adversaries Jose Mourinho and Arsene Wenger renew acquaintances as Arsenal travel to Manchester United, while Manchester City are in London to take on West Ham. There is also a goals round-up from Saturday's seven Premier League games.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 6th May 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights analysis from Sunday's three Premier League games. It promises to be an emotional day at the Emirates Stadium as Arsene Wenger takes charge of an Arsenal home game for the final time, as they face Burnley. At Stamford Bridge Chelsea take on Liverpool, while new champions Manchester City play Huddersfield at the Etihad Stadium, after which they will be presented with the Premier League trophy.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 12th August 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day's three Premier League matches. New Arsenal manager Unai Emery faces a baptism of fire with his first taste of English top-flight football coming against last season's runaway champions Manchester City at the Emirates Stadium. The day's other two opening-round fixtures see Liverpool take on Manuel Pellegrini's new West Ham side and Burnley travel to Southampton. There is also a goals round-up of the seven other Premier League games that have taken place this weekend.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 19th August 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents the best of the action from Sunday's Premier League matches. Champions Manchester City, who won the league title by a record 19 points last season, faced Huddersfield Town, who earned a vital draw in this fixture in 2017-18 to help avoid relegation. Brighton and Hove Albion hosted Manchester United for just the second time in the Premier League, with the home side aiming to repeat their 1-0 victory in May, and Watford visited Burnley.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 26th August 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day's two Premier League matches, with Watford hosting Crystal Palace and Newcastle taking on Chelsea. The latter game sees the Blues looking to avenge their 3-0 loss at St James' Park on the final day of last season. There is also a chance to see all the goals and major incidents from Saturday's matches.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 2nd September 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day's Premier League matches, with newly promoted Cardiff hosting Arsenal, Manchester United travelling to Burnley and Watford taking on Tottenham at Vicarage Road. The last time Cardiff beat the Gunners in all competitions was a Division One match back in 1961. There is also a chance to see all the goals and major incidents from Saturday's matches.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 16th September 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman reviews the day's Premier League action, introducing highlights of Wolverhampton Wanderers v Burnley at Molineux and Everton v West Ham United at Goodison Park. Wolves had made a promising start to life back in the top flight, including a very encouraging 1-1 draw against champions Manchester City last month, while Marco Silva had made a solid start to his tenure as Toffees' boss. Plus, a chance to see all the goals from yesterday's games.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 23rd September 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day's two Premier League fixtures - West Ham United v Chelsea at the London Stadium and Arsenal v Everton at the Emirates Stadium. The Hammers began the season very badly, losing their opening four fixtures, so manager Manuel Pellegrini and the home supporters will have been hoping for a vast improvement against their London rivals. The Gunners lost their opening two games, but bounced back with victories over West Ham and Cardiff City to give new boss Unai Emery his first wins in English football.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 30th September 2018
videos.overview: Highlights and reaction from the day's Premier League fixture between promoted Cardiff City and Burnley, introduced by Jason Mohammad. Both sides have endured a tough start to the domestic season but Cardiff went into the game on a 13-match unbeaten run in this fixture spanning 11 years. There's also a round-up of all the goals from Saturday's eight games, including Chelsea v Liverpool.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 7th October 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of Sunday's three Premier League fixtures, headlined by the heavyweight clash between between Liverpool and Manchester City. The day's other games are the London derby between Fulham and Arsenal and Southampton's meeting with Chelsea. There is also a chance to catch up on all of the goals from the weekend's previous games.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 21st October 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights from the day's Premier League game between Everton and Crystal Palace, plus analysis of the goals and incidents from Saturday's games. Everton recruited manager Marco Silva this summer after a disappointing 2017-18 campaign and spent £35m to prise Brazilian forward Richarlison away from Watford, but their early-season form has been inconsistent. Crystal Palace, meanwhile, will once again hope for a moment of magic from Wilfried Zaha, who has already scored in away wins against Fulham and Huddersfield this season.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 28th October 2018
videos.overview: Highlights from the day's Premier League games, featuring Manchester United's clash with Everton at Old Trafford, Chelsea's visit to Burnley and Crystal Palace facing Arsenal.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 4th November 2018
videos.overview: Highlights from the day's Premier League games, including champions Manchester City taking on Southampton. Also playing were Chelsea, who have made an impressive start to the season under new manager Maurizio Sarri. They take on Crystal Palace at Stamford Bridge. Presenter Mark Chapman also brings you all the goals and talking points from Saturday's matches.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 11th November 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights from a busy day in the Premier League, including the Manchester derby, with Pep Guardiola's City hosting Jose Mourinho's United. Chelsea face Everton, while Arsenal are up against Wolves and Liverpool meet Fulham. There is also a round-up of goals from the other Premier League games that have taken place this weekend.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 25th November 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights from Sunday's two games in the Premier League, featuring resurgent Arsenal's trip to Bournemouth. Both teams enjoyed strong starts to the season, but the Gunners have never lost at home to Bournemouth. In the day's other fixture, newly promoted Wolves hosted Huddersfield.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 2nd December 2018
videos.overview: Highlights of three Premier League derbies, with Liverpool hosting Merseyside rivals Everton, Arsenal taking on Tottenham and another all-London clash between Chelsea and Fulham. Everton have not won away to rivals Liverpool since 1999 so are hoping for a change of fortune under new boss Marco Silva, who took charge this summer. There is also a debutant in the dugout at the north London derby, with Arsenal head coach Unai Emery hoping for a winning start against Tottenham. And at Stamford Bridge, west London pride is at stake as Chelsea take on newly promoted Fulham. Mark Chapman introduces all the action, as well as analysis of the goals and incidents from the rest of the weekend's games.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 9th December 2018
videos.overview: Eilidh Barbour introduces highlights and reaction from St James' Park of the day's solitary Premier League fixture as struggling Newcastle United sought to tame Wolves. Newcastle are unbeaten in six previous Premier League meetings against Wolves, but Sunday's visitors have impressed with their enterprising style of play since returning to the top flight this season after a six-year absence. By contrast, Rafael Benitez's Newcastle took 11 games to earn their first league win of the campaign and have lacked a cutting edge. There's also a round-up of all the goals from Saturday's eight games, including Chelsea v Manchester City.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 16th December 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman introduces highlights and reaction from the day's three crucial Premier League matches, which include Liverpool taking on arch-rivals Manchester United. Jurgen Klopp's side have been among the Premier League pacesetters this season but have struggled against United in recent years - failing to win any of the last eight league meetings. Elsewhere on Sunday, there were two other intriguing clashes with Southampton taking on Arsenal and Chelsea travelling to Brighton. There is also a round-up of all the goals from Saturday's seven games, including Manchester City versus Everton.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 23rd December 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman introduces highlights and reaction from Goodison Park as Everton take on Tottenham in the final Premier League fixture prior to Christmas. Tottenham were looking to maintain their fine record of never having lost to Everton under Mauricio Pochettino's management. Last season they scored seven goals without reply over their two league meetings, including a 3-0 win at Goodison with Harry Kane twice on target. There's also a round-up of all the goals from the weekend's previous games, including Manchester City against Crystal Palace.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 30th December 2018
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day's four Premier League fixtures including Manchester City's visit to Southampton. The home team have won just once in eleven meetings with Pep Guardiola's side, and they were defeated 6-1 at the Etihad Stadium in November. In the day's other three matches, Manchester United host Bournemouth, West Ham United travel to Burnley and Crystal Palace face Chelsea.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 13th January 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day's two Premier League games, with Tottenham hosting Manchester United and Everton facing Bournemouth. Manchester United head to London hoping to avenge their 3-0 defeat by Spurs at Old Trafford in August. Everton, meanwhile, are hoping to extend their perfect home record against Bournemouth, having won all five of their previous games against the Cherries at Goodison Park in all competitions. There is also a round-up of the goals and incidents from the rest of the weekend's matches.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 20th January 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights and discussion of the day's Premier League action, featuring two sides struggling to survive pitted against opponents who continue to thrive. Relegation-threatened Huddersfield Town conceded six goals against champions Manchester City early in the season and have only won one of their last 11 home games in this fixture. At Craven Cottage, Fulham face a Spurs side which have triumphed on their last four visits. There is also a round-up of all the goals from Saturday's games, including Arsenal v Chelsea.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 3rd February 2019
videos.overview: Gabby Logan presents highlights and reaction of the day’s two heavyweight Premier League encounters as Manchester City entertain Arsenal and Manchester United visit Leicester. Manchester City host Arsenal looking to complete the league double over the Gunners for the second straight season. The 2017-18 champions won 2-0 at the Emirates earlier this campaign in what was Unai Emery’s first Premier League game as Arsenal boss. The day’s other game sees Manchester United travel to Leicester looking to extend their unbeaten run against the Foxes to 10 games in all competitions. There is also a round-up of all the goals from the weekend’s previous games, including Tottenham against Newcastle.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 10th February 2019
videos.overview: Manchester City’s clash with Chelsea catches the eye as Mark Chapman presents highlights of Sunday’s Premier League matches. The second of Sunday’s fixtures is equally enticing with another of the title-chasers Tottenham taking on Leicester City at Wembley. There is also a round-up of all the goals from Saturday’s seven games, including Liverpool v Bournemouth.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 24th February 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman introduces highlights and reaction from the day’s two Premier League games, including Manchester United v Liverpool at Old Trafford. It promised to be a fascinating clash between two north west rivals, with United, resurgent under Ole Gunnar Solskjaer, taking on Liverpool, who have the league title firmly in their sights. The day’s other game was in London, with Arsenal hosting Southampton at the Emirates.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 3rd March 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s three Premier League games, including the Merseyside derby, where Everton will try to derail Liverpool’s title challenge. The Toffees have not beaten the Reds since 2010 but will hope to capitalise on any nerves from Jurgen Klopp’s side. Liverpool last won the league in 1990, meaning they have yet to lift the Premier League trophy. There’s another derby match in west London, where relegation-threatened Fulham host a Chelsea side desperate for points in their bid to earn a top-four spot. The day’s third game sees Watford host Leicester at Vicarage Road, with the Hornets hoping to avenge December’s 2-0 defeat to the Foxes. There is also analysis of the goals and incidents from the rest of the weekend’s matches.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 10th March 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s three Premier League games, including the blockbuster clash between Arsenal and Manchester United. Ole Gunnar Solskjaer’s Red Devils have already won at the Emirates this season courtesy of a superb 3-1 victory in the FA Cup fourth round. With the battle for Champions League qualification places intensifying, this game could carry huge significance in the race for the top four. Elsewhere, title-chasing Liverpool welcome Burnley to Anfield, and Chelsea face a Wolves side that beat them earlier this season. There is also analysis of the goals and incidents from the rest of the weekend’s matches.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 17th March 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s two Premier League games, including title-chasing Liverpool’s trip to struggling Fulham. In a crucial day at the top of the table, Chelsea were also in action, travelling to Merseyside for a battle of the Blues against Everton.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 31st March 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights and discussion of the day’s two Premier League games, with title-chasing Liverpool hosting Spurs and struggling Cardiff at home to Chelsea. Liverpool have a fantastic recent home record against Tottenham, with only one defeat in 24 Premier League meetings at Anfield. However, they can ill-afford a repeat of last season’s game, in which Harry Kane denied them victory with a stoppage-time penalty. Cardiff were thumped 4-1 at Chelsea back in September and both sides are desperate for the three points as they seek to reach their goals at opposite ends of the table. There’s also a round-up of all the goals from Saturday’s seven games, including Fulham against Manchester City.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 7th April 2019
videos.overview:
Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s Premier League action featuring Everton’s clash with top four-chasing Arsenal.

In their meeting at Goodison Park last season, the Gunners thrashed the Toffees 5-2 in a pulsating match after Everton midfielder Idrissa Gueye was sent off.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 14th April 2019
videos.overview: Highlights of a potentially critical day in the Premier League title race, as Liverpool host Chelsea at Anfield and Manchester City travel to Crystal Palace. For the Merseysiders, it could be a chance to lay to rest the ghosts of their 2-0 loss to Chelsea in April 2014. The Reds had looked on course to win their first Premier League title that season, but defeat at Anfield – precipitated by Steven Gerrard’s infamous slip – ultimately saw them pipped at the post by Manchester City. City, meanwhile, also face a tricky task as they take on a Palace side that beat them 3-2 in the reverse fixture thanks to an Andros Townsend wonder goal. There is also analysis of the goals and incidents from the rest of the weekend’s matches.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 21st April 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s three Premier League matches, along with all the goals from yesterday’s top-flight games. Liverpool continued their quest for a first league title in almost 30 years against Cardiff City, while Everton hosted Manchester United and Crystal Palace visited Arsenal in a London derby.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 28th April 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s two Premier League matches that could have huge ramifications at the top end of the table. Title-chasing Manchester City face a tricky trip to play struggling Burnley. They were held 1-1 last season at Turf Moor, but have since beaten Sean Dyche’s side 5-0 twice already this season. Elsewhere, Manchester United welcome Chelsea to Old Trafford in a match that could prove decisive in the hotly contested battle for a place in the Champions League. Plus all the goals from the rest of the weekend’s games.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 5th May 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman introduces the goals, action and reaction from the day’s three Premier League fixtures, including Chelsea’s home game against FA Cup finalists Watford. Watford have beaten Chelsea only once in 15 encounters in all competitions, but that win was an emphatic 4-1 victory last season. The day’s other games see Arsenal versus Brighton and Manchester United’s trip to relegated Huddersfield. Huddersfield won last season’s corresponding fixture 2-1 in what remains one of the standout moments of their two-year Premier League stay.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 11th August 2019
videos.overview: Highlights of the final three matches of the opening weekend of the new Premier League season, including Frank Lampard’s league debut as Chelsea boss at Manchester United. Lampard, Chelsea’s all-time record scorer, took his Derby side to Old Trafford last season in the League Cup, with his side winning on penalties. Can he enjoy a similar dream result in what is the highlight of the first round of games? Newcastle take on Arsenal as they adjust to life without Rafa Benitez, while 2015-16 title winners Leicester host last season’s surprise package Wolves.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 18th August 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights from today’s two Premier League games, in which Chelsea hosted Leicester City and Crystal Palace visited newly promoted Sheffield United. For Chelsea head coach Frank Lampard, it would be a first home match in charge, with the midfield legend sure to get a rousing reception from the Stamford Bridge faithful. There will also be a round-up of the goals from yesterday’s top-flight games.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 25th August 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of Sunday’s two mouthwatering fixtures from the Premier League. Reigning champions Manchester City are the first side in action on Sunday afternoon, with Pep Guardiola’s side making the long trip to the south coast to face AFC Bournemouth. Tottenham Hotspur – the side that saw off City in last season’s Champions League quarter-final – are also in action, taking on a Newcastle United side who will be desperate to start the season well under new boss Steve Bruce. There is also a round-up of the goals from Saturday’s top-flight games.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 1st September 2019
videos.overview: The Premier League puts on its Sunday best with the raucous atmosphere and riveting action of the North London derby, plus an intriguing game between ambitious Everton and Wolves. Arsenal are unbeaten at home to Tottenham in the Premier League since 2010 and came from behind to deservedly win 4-2 in the corresponding fixture last season. Both clubs broke their transfer records over the summer in an attempt to bridge the gap at the top of the table. Everton and Wolves finished as the best of the rest outside the top six last season and have also spent heavily over the summer. Wolves won 3-1 at Goodison Park in the New Year, although the headlines went to a black cat on the pitch which held up play for several minutes. There’s also a round-up of all the goals from Saturday’s eight games.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 15th September 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman and guests discuss the goals, drama and major talking points from today’s two Premier League fixtures. Everton began this campaign with ambitions of breaking into the top six, and they travelled to Bournemouth today having played out a thrilling 2-2 draw on the south coast last season, in which both teams ended with ten men. In today’s other contest, Watford hosted Arsenal having beaten the Gunners just once at home since 1987.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 22nd September 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s four mouthwatering fixtures from the Premier League, with Liverpool, Chelsea, Manchester United and Arsenal all in action. Chelsea face Liverpool in a heavyweight clash at Stamford Bridge. It is the second meeting between the clubs this season after European champions Liverpool won the Uefa Super Cup on penalties against Europa League winners Chelsea last month following an entertaining 2-2 draw between the sides. They day’s other games see West Ham take on Manchester United at the London Stadium, Wolves travel to Crystal Palace and Arsenal host promoted Aston Villa. There will also be a round-up of the goals from the seven Premier League’s games to have already taken place this weekend.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 29th September 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s only match in the Premier League as Leicester host Newcastle at the King Power Stadium. Brendan Rodgers’ side have started the season in superb form with their England stars - past, present and potentially future - in top form. Jamie Vardy, James Maddison and Hamza Choudhury have been to the fore as they have negotiated a tricky run of games in style. Newcastle are still finding their feet under new boss Steve Bruce but enjoyed a landmark victory at Champions League finalists Tottenham.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 6th October 2019
videos.overview: Highlights from an action-packed day featuring four Premier League games, with Arsenal, Chelsea and both Manchester clubs amongst the teams on duty. Champions Manchester City face a tricky encounter with Wolves, who were one of just six teams to take points off Pep Guardiola’s side last season. City’s local rivals Manchester United, meanwhile, travel to Tyneside to face a Newcastle side managed by former Red Devils player Steve Bruce. Bournemouth face a testing away game at Arsenal, where they have lost all four of their previous Premier League matches, while Southampton host Chelsea. There is also analysis of the goals and incidents from the rest of the weekend’s matches, presented by Reshmin Chowdhury.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 20th October 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the mouthwatering contest between arch rivals Manchester United and Liverpool. Despite being title hopefuls in recent seasons, Liverpool are winless on their last five league visits to Old Trafford, although they secured a goalless draw last season on their way to just missing out on a maiden Premier League title.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 27th October 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s mouthwatering fixtures from the Premier League, with Liverpool, Tottenham, Manchester United and Arsenal all in action. Liverpool host Spurs in a heavyweight clash at Anfield in what is the first meeting between the sides since last season’s Champions League final. The day’s other games see Manchester United travel to Norwich, Arsenal entertain Crystal Palace and Newcastle take on Wolves. There will also be a round-up of the goals from the six Premier League’s games to have already taken place this weekend.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 3rd November 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today's two fixtures from the Premier League as Crystal Palace host Leicester and Tottenham travel to play Everton at Goodison Park. Brendan Rodgers's Leicester side have started the season in superb form as they attempt to break the stranglehold of the established big six teams and qualify for the Champions League. They take on a Palace team that have posted some impressive results of their own. Tottenham and Everton, on the other hand, have both endured wretched starts to the campaign and will be looking to find some form to ignite their seasons. There will also be a round-up of the goals from the eight Premier League games to have already taken place this weekend.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 10th November 2019
videos.overview: Highlights from today’s three Premier League games, including the mouthwatering clash between title rivals Liverpool and Manchester City at Anfield. Last season Liverpool were crowned champions of Europe but narrowly missed out on a first league title since 1990. They ended second to City despite an incredible haul of 97 points – the third highest in top-flight history. The only game the Merseysiders lost came against Pep Guardiola’s side, so victory at Anfield would be a huge step towards a first Premier League title for them. Elsewhere, Wolves and Aston Villa lock horns at Molineux, while Manchester United host Brighton at Old Trafford. There is also analysis of the goals and incidents from the rest of the weekend’s matches, presented by Mark Chapman.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 24th November 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman introduces highlights from Bramall Lane as Sheffield United host Manchester United in today's Premier League clash. Newly promoted Sheffield United have impressed on their return to the top flight and will be hoping to add another high-profile scalp to a campaign that has already seen the Blades defeat Arsenal and Everton. You can also catch up on all of the goals and talking points from Saturday's eight fixtures.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 1st December 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman introduces highlights of Sunday’s four Premier League games, featuring the three promoted sides, two vulnerable members of the established top six and in-form Leicester. Manchester United and Arsenal were seeking to climb the table by continuing their dominant records against Aston Villa and Norwich respectively, while last season’s most impressive promoted side, Wolves, hosted this season’s high-flying newcomers, Sheffield United. At the King Power Stadium, Leicester and Everton faced each other in a dress rehearsal for their EFL Cup quarter-final tie later in the month. There is also a round-up of all the goals from Saturday’s six games.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 8th December 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day’s four mouthwatering fixtures from the Premier League, with high-flying Leicester among the clubs in action. Brendan Rodgers's Leicester side travel across the Midlands to take on Aston Villa. It is their first trip to Villa Park since a 1-1 draw in January 2016, the same season the Foxes stunned the football world to claim a maiden Premier League title. The day’s other games see Southampton travel to Newcastle, Brighton entertain Wolves and Norwich host Sheffield United in a battle of last season’s top two in the Championship. There will also be a round-up of the goals from the five Premier League games to have already taken place this weekend.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 15th December 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s three mouth-watering fixtures from the Premier League, with the standout fixture being Arsenal’s match against Manchester City. Pep Guardiola’s defending champions have won on their last three visits to face Arsenal at the Emirates Stadium and are undefeated in five against the Gunners. Unai Emery’s Arsenal side have had a mixed start to the season and have struggled in recent seasons against the big teams. In the day’s other matches, Tottenham face a tricky trip to Molineux to take on Wolves, who have proven hard to beat this campaign, while Manchester United host Everton at Old Trafford.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 22nd December 2019
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights from the day’s two Premier League games, with Tottenham taking on London rivals Chelsea and Watford hosting Manchester United. Spurs’ slow start to the season saw them sack Mauricio Pochettino in November. He was replaced by former Chelsea and Manchester United boss Jose Mourinho, who now comes face to face with Frank Lampard – once one of his key players at Stamford Bridge and now the Blues head coach. Relegation-threatened Watford, meanwhile, hopes to cause an upset as they take on an inconsistent Manchester United side at Vicarage Road. There is also analysis of the goals and incidents from the rest of the weekend’s matches.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 29th December 2019
videos.overview: Highlights from today's three Premier League games as Arsenal host Chelsea, Liverpool play Wolves and Manchester City meet Sheffield United. The London derby at the Emirates sees Arsenal and Chelsea clash for the first time since May's Europa League final, which the Blues won 4-1. Wolves have already won away to Man City this season and will be hopeful of claiming another famous scalp as they take on Liverpool at Anfield. City, meanwhile, will need to be wary against a Sheffield United side who have caught many opponents by surprise since winning promotion. There is also analysis of the goals and incidents from the rest of the weekend's matches, presented by Mark Chapman.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 12th January 2020
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s two crucial fixtures from the Premier League, including Aston Villa’s game against defending champions Manchester City. Pep Guardiola’s side will be desperate to earn all three points at Villa Park given their stuttering start to the 2019-20 season. They’ll head to Birmingham confident, however, given that they are unbeaten in their last seven games against Villa. In the day's other match, Watford travel to the south coast to take on Bournemouth in what is a must-win match for the struggling Hornets.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 19th January 2020
videos.overview: Join Mark Chapman and guests as they analyse today’s Premier League matches, including title-chasing Liverpool’s blockbuster clash with Manchester United at Anfield. Jurgen Klopp’s team are bidding for a first league title in the Premier League era and will want three points against their arch-rivals. Liverpool’s triumph in this encounter last season was a first league win at home against United for five years. In today’s other fixture, Leicester City were aiming to keep pace at the top of the table when they travelled to Burnley.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 2nd February 2020
videos.overview: Reshmin Chowdhury presents highlights of the day’s two fixtures from the Premier League, with Manchester City travelling to Tottenham and Burnley hosting Arsenal. Pep Guardiola’s City side have beaten Tottenham in five of their past seven encounters but it was Spurs who famously emerged victorious on away goals in last season’s Champions League quarter-final. August’s reverse league fixture ended in a 2-2 draw with Tottenham twice coming from behind to rescue a point. The day’s other fixture sees Arsenal travel to Burnley looking to preserve their fine record against the Clarets, having won each of their past 11 matches in all competitions. There is also a round-up of the goals from the weekend's other eight Premier League games.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 9th February 2020
videos.overview: Mark Chapman presents highlights of today’s Premier League fixture as Sheffield United host Bournemouth. Sheffield United’s first game back in the Premier League for 12 years ended with a 1-1 draw away at Bournemouth, but since then both clubs have had vastly differing seasons. Chris Wilder’s Blades have been the surprise package of the season while Eddie Howe’s Cherries are struggling near the foot of the table.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 16th February 2020
videos.overview: Highlights of today’s two Premier League matches. Aston Villa host Tottenham, while Arsenal are in action against Newcastle. Tottenham came from behind to beat Villa 3-1 on the opening weekend, but inconsistent form during the autumn eventually saw manager Mauricio Pochettino replaced by Jose Mourinho. If Mourinho is to guide Spurs to European qualification, they may need to beat a Villa side who have spent most of the season battling relegation. It’s a similar story for Arsenal, who sacked head coach Unai Emery in November, replacing him with Mikel Arteta. His team will need to be wary against a Newcastle side who have already beaten Chelsea, Manchester United and Spurs this season. videos.title: MOTD2 - 8th March 2020

videos.title: MOTD2 - 21st June 2020

Jurgen Klopp's Reds were looking to record their third consecutive victory in all competitions against their bitter rivals, and the omens looked good with the Toffees' last triumph coming way back in October 2010. Villa had a similarly poor recent record against Chelsea, having lost their previous five meetings, while the Blades hadn't beaten the Magpies since November 2006.

videos.title: MOTD2 - 19th September 2021
videos.overview:
Mark Chapman presents highlights from today’s three Premier League games, including a mouthwatering clash between Tottenham and Chelsea.

This fixture has developed into one of the fieriest in the top flight and has seen some notable battles over recent years. Chelsea currently have the upper hand, and they have won both of their league matches at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium without conceding a goal.

There was another fascinating encounter in London today as West Ham faced Manchester United. The Hammers may have won just seven of their previous 50 Premier League matches against the Red Devils, but David Moyes’s side will be confident of a rare victory over their Manchester rivals given their impressive form over the last 12 months.

Leicester City were also in action today as they travelled south to take on Brighton. The show will also include all the goals from Saturday’s Premier League matches.

The Gunners spent heavily to strengthen their squad in the summer, and the pressure is on boss Mikel Arteta to produce results sooner rather than later. Tottenham, meanwhile, managed to hold on to star striker Harry Kane despite interest from Manchester City, and their new head coach Nuno Espirito Santo will be optimistic his squad is good enough for a top-four finish.

Nuno’s former club Wolves will be hoping to extend their good recent record against Southampton. The Molineux club – now coached by Bruno Lage – have lost one of six league matches against Saints since promotion in 2018.

videos.overview: Mark Chapman introduces highlights of the day's two Premier League games, with runaway leaders Liverpool hosting Spurs and Manchester United travelling to Bournemouth. The Cherries are unbeaten in three previous meetings between the sides, and Andoni Iraola's men are vying to complete a first ever league double over United after winning 3-0 at Old Trafford earlier this season. It's largely been a campaign to forget for the Red Devils, who need points to avoid finishing in the bottom half of the Premier League for the very first time.
